title: ananas bracteatus var. sagenarius
intro: Ananas bracteatus var. sagenarius, commonly known as the Pineapple Guava or Pseidon Pineapple, is a plant species within the Bromeliad family. This plant is known for its edible fruits and has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Ananas bracteatus var. sagenarius include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include bromelain, a mixture of proteolytic enzymes, as well as ascorbic acid and other flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
